title: Supreme Court Courts
description: content/supreme-court/courts.yaml: each Court of the Supreme Court of the United States that has a page on the site, named for its Chief Justice, with a short history in the project's own words (site/src/lib/server/supreme-courts.ts). Who sat on each Court comes from justices.yaml. scripts/validate_records.py checks that each chief is a Chief Justice in justices.yaml and that each [@key] names a source record.

key.description: The Court's name as a slug, for example marshall-court.

chief.description: The Chief Justice's name exactly as justices.yaml gives it.

history.description: Markdown with [@key] citations of source records.
